title: D24 escalation parameters offered only where reachable
note: D35 candidate: bake-rs offers sandbox_permissions and justification only for modes an approval could grant, so print mode under the default workspace-write preset sends Pi schemas for bash, edit, and write, no retry sentences in the bash description, no escalation hint on a denial, and a never sentence without its sandbox_permissions clause. Both arms are native bake-rs builds under EVAL_NATIVE_PERMISSION=workspace-write with bash confined by bubblewrap on Linux. gemini-3.8-flash-high at medium effort substitutes for the standard gemini-3.8-flash-medium alias, which the gateway does not list. Findings: GPT filled sandbox_permissions throughout the base arm, always with the standing workspace-write, and never in the candidate, which has no such parameter. All six GPT base failures are the runaway guard: each streamed about 2,000 whitespace characters after the required arguments of an edit call, where only the D24 parameters remained; the candidate had no runaway and passes 21/21. Total tokens fall on every model, by 7.6% to 13.2%, with intervals below zero except DeepSeek Flash and Gemini, and requests are unchanged within their intervals. The one flag, Gemini tool errors 1 to 3, is accepted: three are git commands run in the fixture, which is not a repository (one base, two candidate), and one is the candidate running the test before its fix; none is a sandbox denial or concerns the parameters.

settings.effort: medium where the model offers it; DeepSeek runs at high, its default, having no medium

regressionRule: all tasks, per model: total tokens with the 95% interval above zero; requests up more than 10% with the 95% interval above zero; failures +2 or more; any tool-error increase
